reapack.name: FX Link.lua
reapack.desc: FX Link: copy settings between plugin instances, or keep them in sync

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20 {\b\fs28 FX Link}\par\par Link instances of the same plugin, e.g. on double-tracked parts panned hard left/right. With Sync on, changing any linked instance changes all of them. Or copy settings one-off.\par\par \bullet Works with VST, VST3, CLAP, JSFX and AU plugins\par \bullet Two-way sync of parameters, including automation and presets\par \bullet Optional sync of internal state, for plugins whose knobs are not parameters\par \bullet Per-group parameter exclusions (e.g. keep each side's pan)\par \bullet Groups are saved in the project\par Requires REAPER 7 and the ReaImGui extension (0.10 or newer, available via ReaPack). Sync runs while the FX Link window is open.\par\par }
